name: Mt. Ember & Team Rocket Outpost
summary: Ascend the volcanic crags of Mt. Ember. Confront and defeat the Team Rocket grunts scheming outside their western cave hideout. The liberated sailor gratefully awards you the Seagallop Pass, unlocking regular ferry transit across the Sevii archipelago. Navigate 1F caverns to collect a Magmarizer and Fire Stone, and discover the Power Plant Key near Moltres's summit nest.

items.name: Seagallop Pass
items.method: Awarded by the Sailor after driving Team Rocket away from Mt. Ember

items.name: TM50 Overheat
items.method: On the western beach, behind the blocking Corsolas (scare away with Mareanie/Toxapex)

items.name: Magmarizer
items.method: Found on the ground along the eastern volcanic path

items.name: Fire Stone
items.method: On the ground near the entrance to the Team Rocket hideout

items.name: Power Plant Key
items.method: Found lying on the ground near Moltres's summit chamber

trainers.name: Team Rocket Grunt
trainers.strategy: Ground-type Earthquake cleans up both Poison hybrids swiftly.

trainers.name: Pokémon Ranger Beth
trainers.strategy: Fire and Ice STAB incinerate her Grass-heavy team with ease.
